mainEntity.name: Can I avoid a driving ban under the totting-up procedure?

acceptedAnswer.text: An exceptional-hardship argument is available in some cases. It is not automatic. The first call covers whether the argument is realistic on your facts.

mainEntity.name: I was over the drink drive limit — is there any defence?

acceptedAnswer.text: There can be, depending on procedure at the roadside and at the station. The disclosure is reviewed before any plea is advised.

mainEntity.name: Will I lose my job if I lose my driving licence?

acceptedAnswer.text: For many clients the answer drives the case. Hardship arguments are built around exactly this kind of personal consequence and the specific impact on livelihood.
